author: Michael Pollan
title: A World Appears
claim: Consciousness can be investigated through first-person experience alongside scientific, literary and contemplative accounts.

author: Gabor Maté
title: Interview on trauma, addiction and healing
claim: Maté distinguishes an adverse event from the internal wound a person carries afterward.

author: Richard P. Feynman, Robert B. Leighton and Matthew Sands
title: The Feynman Lectures on Physics III, chapter 1
claim: When alternatives remain indistinguishable in the two-slit setup, the probability depends on the squared magnitude of the sum of amplitudes.

author: Neil deGrasse Tyson
title: The Cosmic Perspective
claim: Tyson draws a sense of kinship from shared chemistry and the atomic continuity of life with the wider universe.

author: Michio Kaku
title: Consciousness Can Be Quantified
claim: Kaku proposes describing consciousness through feedback that models a being in space, social relations and time, including anticipation.

author: Giacomo Mauro D’Ariano and Federico Faggin
title: Hard Problem and Free Will: an information-theoretical approach
claim: The authors propose that a system’s definite experience corresponds to a pure quantum state and distinguish this from an external observer’s description.

author: Marco Masi
title: Quantum Indeterminacy and Libertarian Panpsychism
claim: Masi interprets quantum indeterminacy in terms of agency and proposes a universal consciousness.

author: Stuart Hameroff and Roger Penrose
title: Orchestrated reduction of quantum coherence in brain microtubules
claim: The authors propose a particular physical substrate and objective reduction as contributors to conscious events.

author: Max Tegmark
title: Importance of quantum decoherence in brain processes
claim: For the modeled neural systems and assumptions, decoherence times are much shorter than the neural dynamics considered.

author: Joshua S. Siegel and colleagues
title: Psilocybin desynchronizes the human brain
claim: Changes in functional connectivity after psilocybin covaried with ratings of subjective experience in intensively imaged participants.

author: Decoding the Self study team
title: Decoding the Self: Single-Trial Prediction of Self-Boundary Meditation States From Magnetoencephalography Recordings
claim: Meditators alternated between maintaining and dissolving a felt self-boundary during MEG recording, permitting a within-task comparison.

author: Nanoparticle matter-wave interferometry study team
title: Probing quantum mechanics with nanoparticle matter-wave interferometry
claim: The researchers measured matter-wave interference of sodium clusters under controlled conditions.

author: Institute for the Study of Ancient Cultures, University of Chicago
title: Clepsydra, museum object record
claim: The catalogued Egyptian stone outflow clock preserves internal divisions and physical features that can be examined.

author: James Lind
title: A Treatise of the Scurvy, 1753 edition
claim: Lind records a comparison of six proposed treatments for sailors with scurvy in his account of the 1747 investigation.

author: Yannis Assael and colleagues
title: Restoring and attributing ancient texts using deep neural networks
claim: The authors tested restoration and attribution on Greek inscriptions and evaluated historians working with system suggestions.

author: D. M. Eigler and E. K. Schweizer
title: Positioning single atoms with a scanning tunnelling microscope
claim: The authors positioned individual xenon atoms on a surface using a scanning tunnelling microscope.

author: Masatsugu Toyota and colleagues
title: Glutamate triggers long-distance, calcium-based plant defense signaling
claim: Wounding triggered calcium signals reaching distant plant tissue, with a role for glutamate and glutamate receptor-like channels.

author: Human Developmental Biology Resource
title: 3D human embryo models
claim: The atlas organizes embryonic specimens by Carnegie stage and supplies three-dimensional anatomical models.

author: Rice water use efficiency study team
title: Water Use Efficiency and Physiological Response of Rice Cultivars under Alternate Wetting and Drying Conditions
claim: The study compares cultivar responses to different water regimes, distinguishing water input, plant response and yield.

author: Planck Collaboration
title: Planck 2018 results VI. Cosmological parameters
claim: The collaboration estimates cosmological parameters under specified models using cosmic microwave background data.

author: ATLAS Collaboration
title: A Particle Consistent with the Higgs Boson Observed with the ATLAS Detector at the Large Hadron Collider
claim: ATLAS observed a new particle in collider data consistent with a Higgs boson, testing specific predictions through decay signatures.

author: Itay Shani
title: Cosmopsychism: A Holistic Approach to the Metaphysics of Experience
claim: A cosmic consciousness is proposed as the ground from which individual experiencing subjects arise.

author: Johnjoe McFadden
title: Integrating information in the brain’s EM field: the cemi field theory of consciousness
claim: The author proposes that integrated information in the brain’s own electromagnetic field is causally involved in conscious experience.

author: Human magnetophosphene replication study team
title: Reproducible magnetophosphene thresholds induced by transcranial alternating magnetic stimulation in humans
claim: Under controlled exposure an alternating magnetic field reproducibly induced a flickering visual percept consistent with retinal mediation.
